# Emelia

> Emelia is a B2B prospecting platform: multichannel campaigns (email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp), contact lists, Email Finder, Phone Finder, Email Verifier, warmup and a unified inbox. This is the developer documentation of its REST API, its MCP server and its AI tooling.

Key facts:

- REST API base URL: https://api.emelia.io (lists and contacts are served under https://api.emelia.io/lists, same key)
- Authentication: send your 48 character API key in the `Authorization` header, as is (a `Bearer ` prefix is accepted). Create the key at https://v3.emelia.io/settings/api. A key gives access to the whole account.
- Rate limit per account and per minute: 30 without a plan, 100 Start, 300 Grow, 1,000 Scale. `/tools` and `/lists` routes are not counted. Over the limit the API answers HTTP 500 (not 429): wait for the next minute.
- Errors: `{ "error", "code"?, "params"? }`; "not found" is HTTP 400 on the main API. The lists service answers `{ "message", "code"? }` with real 404, 413 and 422.
- Credits: Email Finder 1 (refunded when nothing is found), Phone Finder 50 (refunded when nothing is found), Email Verifier 0.25 (never refunded).
- OpenAPI specs: https://docs.emelia.io/openapi/emelia.json and https://docs.emelia.io/openapi/inbox.json (Emelia Inbox API, same API key)
- MCP server: https://mcp.emelia.io/mcp (Streamable HTTP, same API key in the `Authorization` header, raw or `Bearer`, or in `X-Api-Key`)
- Every page is available as Markdown: append `.md` to its URL. All pages in one file: https://docs.emelia.io/llms-full.txt
- Step and version `_id` values of a campaign sequence are MongoDB ObjectIds (24 lowercase hex characters), never UUIDs. The simplest is to omit them: the server generates them.

### Enrichment

- [Enrichment](https://docs.emelia.io/docs/enrichment.md): Find professional emails, find phone numbers and verify addresses with the Emelia enrichment API. Every call starts a job that you poll until it is done.

#### Email Finder

- [Email Finder](https://docs.emelia.io/docs/enrichment/email-finder.md): Find the professional email address of a person from a full name, a company and a country, with the Emelia Email Finder API. 1 credit, refunded when nothing is found.

#### Phone Finder

- [Phone Finder](https://docs.emelia.io/docs/enrichment/phone-finder.md): Find the phone number of a person from a LinkedIn profile URL with the Emelia Phone Finder API. 50 credits, refunded when no number is found.

#### Email Verifier

- [Email Verifier](https://docs.emelia.io/docs/enrichment/email-verifier.md): Verify that an email address can receive mail before you send, with the Emelia Email Verification API. 0.25 credit per verification.
